notes:
Faster handoff to region search

- Automatic region lookup remains limited to the 30 servers on the current UI page. Only the circular search scans additional candidates for the selected region and player order.
- Region search no longer waits for all requests from a cancelled page to finish. It can use free request slots immediately while slow requests complete in the background.
- Reuse addresses returned by cancelled page requests to avoid duplicate address lookups.
- Keep the actual shared six-request concurrency limit, cached and offline geolocation, and Roblox rate-limit handling.
